name: Nike Air Zoom Vomero 5 'Supersonic'
story_html: The Nike Air Zoom Vomero 5 ‘Supersonic’ features an airy white mesh upper reinforced with black synthetic leather detailing at the forefoot and heel. Glow-in-the-dark accents make their way to the molded heel counter and quarter-panel cage, overlaid with a signature Swoosh in synthetic white leather. Lightweight cushioning is provided by a full-length Phylon midsole, fitted with Zoom Air cushioning and supported by a glow-in-the-dark rubber outsole.
